# Native Works

Sovereign digital production studio. We build owned website infrastructure, AI-powered workflows, and private data pipelines. Your site. Your audience. Your revenue. Nobody's platform. Yours forever.

## Core Products

- **Stack**: The complete sovereign setup. Domain, hosting, custom site, and payment rails (Stripe, BTCPay) running on your own infrastructure. Details: [https://nativeworks.studio/#products](https://nativeworks.studio/#products).
- **Foundation**: Brand identity and full website build deployed on sovereign infrastructure, with 90 days of guided ownership. Details: [https://nativeworks.studio/#products](https://nativeworks.studio/#products).
- **Enterprise Private LLM Pipelines**: Local ETL preprocessing (PDF/doc ingestion, segmenting, chunking) and private LLM nodes (Llama, Mistral) running on secure VPS (Hetzner, OVH) or bare-metal hardware. Details: [https://nativeworks.studio/business.html](https://nativeworks.studio/business.html).
